required_prose_correction.finding: The prose says that a fixed history has mass alpha*pi0*r^s*(1-r)^f without explicitly restricting that displayed equality to compatible histories. For incompatible action/receipt words the actual mass is zero, while the displayed right-hand expression need not be zero. The preceding positive-history posterior formula helps context but does not make this separate fixed-history sentence unambiguous.
required_prose_correction.source_evidence: RegisterDecisionCountHistory.initial_likelihood_counts and rawPriorMass_eq explicitly take CompatibleHistory. incompatible_prior_mass_zero proves the excluded case; positive_history then establishes compatibility and positive factors on actual positive histories.
required_prose_correction.requested_edit: Write that this factorization holds for receipt-compatible fixed histories, and state that incompatible histories have actual mass zero; alternatively limit the displayed formula explicitly to positive-mass histories. Keep the derived positivity and cancellation argument.

precision_edits.finding: Current conditional language is consistent with soundness, but the absence of a general generate-always-accepted theorem is not stated explicitly.
precision_edits.requested_edit: State that the theorem proves correctness of a candidate accepted by the exact checker, while no theorem that generate is accepted for every lawful input is claimed; registered actual accepted runs remain separate evidence.

precision_edits.finding: The wording separately reports compilation/loading could be read as a separately measured loading stage. The actual new entry provides total wall time including loading and separately measured internal stages.
precision_edits.requested_edit: Say that records retain compilation results and an entry wall clock including loading, and separately report generation, serialization, checks and the other measured internal stages.

visual_findings.finding: The five-row 39.83 receipt-information table breaks after its fourth row. The missing-slot row is alone at the top of the next page with a repeated header. Information is not lost, but the short comparison table should remain together if possible.

The last appendix-C paragraph leaves only two lines on page 88, splitting the delivery-link label at the page break. A modest tightening of the new appendix prose can keep the closing paragraph on page 87.
The chapter ends with four lines on an otherwise empty page. This is a readable chapter-tail flow, not clipped text or a source defect; no global book reflow is requested solely for it.
Consumer-table fraction rows are compact but the exact numerators and denominators remain distinguishable. No actual overlap was confirmed.

substantive_checks_passed: The new observer is generated from own actions and receipt projection; no protected program, true parent, hidden label, whole-Store or theta oracle is supplied to the controller.

Normal/fault receipt coincidence is handled correctly: damaged idle and nonexistent slot 00 are uninformative, while healthy idle and existing-slot writes identify normal versus fault. Endpoint rates, zero priors, 0^0 and off-support default normalization are accurately separated from positive-mass conditioning.
The sufficient-statistic statement is joint and covers every legal action, not just a chosen policy. Original complete-history real-randomized supported-admissible competitors remain in scope.

The actual Array node bound is correctly stated as 24*(H+1)^4 under row bounds and key injectivity. It is not represented as a total-memory or total-polynomial-time bound; exact rational and external compute costs are retained.

The true-merge witness is explicitly equality of conditional future behavior and continuation value. Different native identities, tails, past birth times and possibly different realized past discounted payoff remain distinct.

The address-2 counterexample correctly arises from histories reachable under the original 0/1 protocol and marks a changed future permission boundary, not a free extension of the completed source family.

All five table values and proof/execution node counts match the actual independent result summary. H8 is 884450457/1342177280 with 1661 proof nodes, 151 selected-execution nodes, 8221 proof edges and 182 execution edges.

The H8 reported birth/payment quantities match the actual checker: at-least-one birth 215/256, two charges 1233/4096, expected total births 57313/16384 and expected literal total fee 4673/4096. They are not mistaken for discounted net payoff.

The stated H8 stage times, 7.250-second full entry wall time, output byte count and raw macOS/Linux memory figures match the saved execution/check artifacts. No cross-runtime or isolated-solve speed ratio is claimed.

H8 finite path replay is correctly limited to wiring/identity/payment evidence; exact all-action certification plus the general native theorem carries the global optimum. Old successful tree artifacts are reused without rerunning the old 28-minute entry.
Philosophy distinguishes decision memory, full world history and identity, and does not claim internal cognitive hardware, universal two drives, empirical validation or unrestricted new permissions.
